name: preview__Card

props.name: isFlush
props.description: When true, removes all padding so content fills the body edge-to-edge. Use when the body contains a component (e.g. a table, chart, or image) that manages its own internal spacing.

a11y.note: Carbon ships a11y behaviour per component; verify per screen

when_to_use: Use Carbon preview__Card rather than building one.
when_not_to_use: Do not restyle off-token — propose a token instead.
